arguments.value: 68-year-old man with diabetes, hypertension, and COPD presented with progressive low back pain and left L5/S1 radiculopathy refractory to conservative therapy; MRI revealed an L5-S1 epidural/paraspinal abscess. Surgical decompression and debridement grew Streptococcus gallolyticus, prompting colorectal malignancy workup that identified sigmoid adenocarcinoma (stage IIIC, pT3N2bMx).
